name: Neo4j
one_liner: Graph database platform offering self-managed and cloud (AuraDB) deployments for connected data.
auth_notes: Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 client_credentials: client ID and secret sent via HTTP Basic to /oauth/token, returning a bearer token with expires_in 3600.
access_notes: Created in Aura console under Account Settings > Client credentials; all tiers can create credentials; no cost or wait stated. Client secret is shown only once.

buildability.rationale: Aura API credentials are self-serve for all tiers using OAuth client credentials. Endpoint catalog was not in fetched pages. Drivers/Query API vs Aura management API ambiguity is unresolved. Verify endpoints before building.

identity.quote: Discover the client libraries and APIs to develop applications with Neo4j and AuraDB.

auth.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.

access.quote: All tiers can create Aura API credentials.

api_surface.quote: You can use the Authorize button on the Aura API page to authenticate and test endpoints directly using your client ID and client secret.

mcp.quote: Neo4j MCP gives AI assistants and LLM-powered tools direct, structured access to your Neo4j graph database.

buildability.quote: The API credentials never expire unless you delete them.

needs_human_reason: Endpoint catalog not fetched. Confirm whether the target is the Aura management API or the Query API/drivers, and locate a public endpoint list.
